name: qlive-framework-workspace
description: Root front door for the qlive framework developer monorepo. Run pnpm <script>; Maven is invoked under the hood and never needs to be called directly.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "./mvnw -f qlive-test spring-boot:run" "wait-on tcp:8080 && pnpm --filter @quinscape/qlive-test-frontend dev"
